payload.comment: Ablation report is internally consistent and well-designed: three scenarios (unit → standardize → standardize+hflip) share the same split fingerprint and seed (72), showing monotonic gains in both accuracy (0.714→0.754→0.785) and macro-F1 (0.641→0.692→0.729). No deterministic findings. The abstention report's ood_auroc of 0.25401 (below 0.5 chance) is flagged by two anomaly reviewers as a warning; however, it is explicitly scoped as a controlled_corruption_proxy using max_softmax under mild σ=0.25 noise, a known-weak confidence signal. The suggested follow-up—verifying the AUROC convention (P(score|OOD) vs P(score|ID) or possible 1−AUROC inversion)—is reasonable and should be confirmed, but does not invalidate the ablation results or the primary selective-prediction metrics, which are all
llm_issues: ood_auroc=0.25401 is below 0.5 chance; verify AUROC computation convention (P(score|OOD) vs P(score|ID)) and rule out 1−AUROC inversion before citing this metric in any summary
max_softmax is a known-weak OOD signal; consider documenting this limitation explicitly in the ablation/abstention report metadata to prevent misinterpretation of the sub-chance AUROC
Two anomaly reviewers (abstention, comparison) issued action=revise on the AUROC concern; resolve or formally acknowledge before downstream stages consume this value
